# 0xEgg

> Blockchain development studio, EVM indexing tools, and decentralized data infrastructure.

## About
0xEgg builds cross-chain developer tools and analytics applications (including Wallet X-Ray) for Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Polygon, and EVM compatible networks.

## Content & Feeds
- **Blog & Engineering Research**: https://0xegg.com/blog/
  Articles on EVM node clustering, multi-chain indexing pipelines, RPC connection pooling, and smart contract verification.
- **RSS Feed**: https://0xegg.com/rss.xml
- **Sitemap**: https://0xegg.com/sitemap.xml
- **Tools**: https://xray.0xegg.com (Wallet X-Ray)
